name: aichieve-front-end
//: Dependencies are pinned to EXACT versions, not ranges. They mirror the set giniloh.com runs in production. A fresh `^` range install resolved astro 6.4.8 -> vite 8 + rolldown, which @tailwindcss/vite@4.2.x cannot drive (build dies with `Missing field tsconfigPaths`). Keep these in lockstep with giniloh's package-lock and bump them deliberately, in both repos at once.
